name: Anime Midwest
blurb: A three-day anime convention at the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center in Rosemont, Illinois, with cosplay and concerts.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Ready for Anime Midwest? July 2 - 4, 2027'; location page: 'Anime Midwest will be held at the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center in Rosemont, Illinois' and 'July 2 - 4, 2027 Rosemont, Illinois.'

notes: Guests page ('Guests for Chicago Anime Con') rendered only partner/sibling-convention logos and sponsor logos, no guest photos for the 2027 edition yet, hence 'none-yet'. Organizer AnimeCon.org confirmed via the footer, which lists Anime Midwest alongside its sibling events (AniMinneapolis, Anime-zing!, M.A.G.E., Anime-ZAP!).
